name: team-topology-design
description: Design team topology using Team Topologies (stream-aligned / platform / enabling / complicated-subsystem) + interaction modes (collaboration / X-as-a-service / facilitating). Cognitive-load assessment, team boundaries aligned with bounded contexts, team API definition, reverse-Conway maneuvers, team-of-teams patterns, collaboration-tool selection. Anti-patterns (feature teams hiding cognitive debt, shared-services bottlenecks, too-wide stream-aligned scope). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
